name: IncottLineMouse
source_reference: design brief only: the app's own UI design language (ui/style.css tokens; the mouse line art in ui/index.html readout screen). No logo, no bitmap reference.
brief: The readout-screen mouse: graphite stage, white outline mouse drawn as a thick ring made of two filled silhouettes, white scroll wheel, one green lamp dot.

semantic_review.basis: original concept authored in-task from the app's own design language; no external brand mark and no bitmap reference to reproduce
semantic_review.notes: Outline built as a white silhouette with a smaller background-coloured silhouette on top (overlay-fill-layer), because strokes and boolean holes are not allowed in source assets. Thickness is deliberately 40 so the ring survives small sizes.

app_context.job_to_be_done: let the user recognise the mouse driver in the taskbar, Start menu and installer at a glance
app_context.tone: calm, precise, hardware-instrument; no AI-flavoured purple, glow or gradients

style_direction: custom direction from the app UI (单色仪表台); nearest built-in family: black-stage-mark with overlay-created gaps

source_analysis.fidelity_target: the line-art mouse of the app's readout screen (dome, straight sides, rounded bottom, scroll wheel, lamp)
must_preserve: continuous outer ring with even side thickness
scroll wheel pill inside the ring
one green lamp dot on the lower body
acceptance_checks: ring thickness even on all sides at full size
preview and app PNG inspected at 64px

composer.reason: background-coloured overlay that turns the silhouette into a ring without a cutout

layers.name: scroll wheel
